scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.public: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
